name: ask_user
description: Ask a human, or another clanker instance, to choose between concrete options when guessing would waste work: which of two designs to build, which file to change, whether to widen the scope. Only for genuine forks where the options lead to materially different work — do not ask for permission to continue, and do not ask what you can determine by reading the code. Input: {"question": "...", "options": ["...", "..."]} (two or more), plus optional {"peer": "<instance name>"} to ask that peer instead of the human. Returns the chosen option verbatim and who answered. In a non-interactive run with no peer it returns an error saying to decide yourself.

options.description: Two or more concrete options, each phrased as the action it leads to.

peer.description: Name of a peer clanker instance to ask instead of the human (see the peers tool).
